info.title: NetIntel API
info.description:
DNS lookup, WHOIS/RDAP, SSL/TLS certificate checks, email SPF/DKIM/DMARC and deliverability, email verification, IP geolocation and IP reputation, domain age and availability, web page fetch, extract and search, and an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway — 144 pay-per-call endpoints over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana mainnet), no API keys or signup.

NetIntel is agent fair-trade aligned: transparent per-call pricing in USDC on Base or Solana via x402, no API keys or signup, and automatic no-charge on server errors, upstream failures, and input-validation rejections — failed calls are never billed across NetIntel's network, domain, and data-intelligence endpoints.
info.x-guidance: NetIntel provides 144 network intelligence endpoints covering DNS, SSL/TLS, WHOIS/RDAP, email security, web fingerprinting, and OSINT. Every endpoint is pay-per-call via x402 micropayments (USDC on Base or Solana mainnet — no API keys, no subscriptions). Call any endpoint normally; if unpaid it returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements, then pay and retry. The per-call price is in each operation's x-payment-info.

get.summary: Check a password against HaveIBeenPwned breaches
get.description:
Deprecated: sends the `password` in the URL, where it can be retained by edge logs, proxies and shell history. Use POST /breach-check/password and send it in the JSON body instead. This form still works and is still supported for existing callers.

Check if a password has appeared in known data breaches using the HaveIBeenPwned Pwned Passwords API with k-anonymity — the full password is never transmitted, only a 5-character SHA-1 hash prefix — returns breach count and a risk classification so agents can enforce password policies without storing or exposing credentials.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to check against known data breaches (1-500 characters; sent as a query param but only a k-anonymity SHA-1 prefix leaves the server)

x-guidance.outputShape: breached, breach_count, risk_level, score, grade, findings

findings.detail: Password found 34521 times in known data breaches

get.summary: Exa neural web search for AI agents
get.description: Exa neural web search for AI agents — POST or GET a query, get ranked live results (title, url, published_date, author, score) with optional highlight snippets. Filter by category (news, research paper, github, company, pdf, and more), domain include/exclude, and publish date. For a direct answer use /exa/answer. No API key, pay per call on Base or Solana.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query, 1-1000 chars. Aliases: q, search, prompt, text

parameters.name: num_results
parameters.description: 1-10 results (default 10); >10 clamped. Aliases: numResults, limit, n, count

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: company | research paper | news | pdf | github | tweet | personal site | linkedin profile | financial report

parameters.name: include_domains
parameters.description: Up to 20 hostnames to restrict to

parameters.name: snippets
parameters.description: none (default) | highlights | text — clamps num_results to 2

x-guidance.outputShape: query, search_type, num_results, results, provider, findings

get.summary: Fetch clean page text for up to 3 URLs via Exa
get.description: Clean page text for up to 3 URLs in one call via Exa's index + live crawl — works on JS-rendered and bot-walled pages that direct fetch can't read. Returns title, author, published_date and text per URL, with per-URL status. Pairs with /exa/search (search → contents). No API key, pay per call on Base or Solana.

post.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions gateway (alias of /v1/chat/completions for api/v1-style base URLs) — standard request shape, model chosen in the body: any gpt-* chat model (not Claude/embeddings), each at its own price. Priced per model, $0.005–$0.65 per call in USDC via x402, no API key: POST unpaid and the 402 quotes your model's exact price. Supports response_format json_object. Free model catalog: GET /v1/models.

post.description: Generate agent-ready image assets (icons, logos, social graphics, thumbnails, banners) with gpt-image-1. Claude refines the prompt, screens content, adds alt text and a score. Returns image_url as a base64 PNG data URI. Flat $0.25; n=1; ratios 1:1/16:9/9:16.
